notes.title: Implemented patch Ver.1.3.5
notes.content:
We have updated programs related to unlock the achievements.
Please update to the latest version.

notes.title: Implemented a patch Ver1.3.4.
notes.content:
Implemented a patch Ver1.3.4.

-The cleared stage defense rate display has been corrected to cut off. If the stage defense rate has been displayed as 100.0% but the achievement has not been unlocked, please check the correct stage defense rate.
-The jar that catches magic stones has been a little larger.

Please update to the latest version.

notes.title: Negative decopin power gems.
notes.content:
Implemented a patch that releases gems that make decopin power negative.
・After clearing normal mode, it will appear in the shop with a certain probability.
・When equipped, Decopin power becomes negative.
Please update to the latest version of Decopins.

notes.title: Implemented volume adjustment settings and implove some UIs.
notes.content:
We have implemented the followings.

-Implemented BGM/SE volume adjustment settings.
-Speed ​​up the display of the stage clear scene.
-Improved the UI for “Out of Reach.”
-Adjustment of some stage's camera angles and add new music.

Please update to the latest Decopins.

notes.title: SUPER DEATH MODE
notes.content:
For those who easily cleared Death Mode, we have more difficult "SUPER DEATH MODE".
Can you clear it?

*SUPER DEATH MODE can be challenged after clearing Normal Mode.
*Please update "Decopins".
*Have the Achievements for clearing SUPER DEATH MODE.
*The final boss of all modes has become stronger.

More news!
“Decopins2” store page is now open. Scheduled for release in January 2024.
This time Hamburger try to escape!?
